blocks.title: Particulate matter (PM)
blocks.text: “Particulate matter (PM)” un bohat nanhi cheezon ko kehte hain jo hawa mein tairti rehti hain, chahe woh thos zarre (solid particles) hon, liquid ke qatre (droplets) hon, ya dono.

PM hawa mein latki (suspended) saari dhool, dhuan aur dhund (haze) ke zarre hain. PM mein acids, organic chemicals, metals (dhatein) aur mitti ya dhool ke zarre hote hain. PM ke sources natural bhi hain aur anthropogenic (insani) bhi. Natural sources mein volcano, aag, dhool ke toofan (dust storms) aur hawa mein urne wala samandari namak shamil hain. Insani sources mein machines aur factories mein jalna (combustion), gariyon ka dhuan aur tambaku (tobacco) ka dhuan shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: PM10 aur PM2.5 mein farq batayein, aur PM2.5 zyada nuqsan-deh kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: PM10 woh zarre hain jin ka diameter 10 micrometre tak hai; PM2.5 is se bareek, 2.5 micrometre tak. Bareek zarre hawa mein zyada der rehte hain aur naak aur gale se guzar kar phephron ki gehrai (alveoli) aur khoon tak pohnch jate hain, is liye PM2.5 zyada jalan aur dil aur phephron ki bimariyan paida karta hai.

items: PM: hawa mein tairte thos zarre aur liquid qatre (dhool, dhuan, dhund; acids, organics, metals, mitti).
Natural: volcano, aag, dust storms, samandari namak. Insani: combustion, gariyan, tobacco smoke.
